name: Window AC Service & Repair
headline: Your Old Window AC Still Has Years Left in It
summary: Window ACs are simple machines, and simple machines last — if someone clears the dust. We service, deep-clean and repair window units across Chennai, from rental flats in Triplicane to old family homes in Mylapore. Before you price a replacement, let us look at yours — most just need a proper clean and a gas check.

symptoms.title: Airflow has gone weak
symptoms.description: Chennai's dust packs into the filter and blower until the unit pushes warm, feeble air no matter what the knob says.

symptoms.title: Louder rattle and hum
symptoms.description: Loose mounting bolts, a worn blower bearing or a tired fan motor turn a steady drone into a nightly disturbance.

symptoms.title: Cooling has faded
symptoms.description: A coil caked in grime or refrigerant lost through a slow leak makes the compressor run flat out for half the cooling.

symptoms.title: Water dripping into the room
symptoms.description: A clogged drain pan or a unit that has shifted off its tilt sends condensate down your wall instead of outside.

symptoms.title: Musty smell on startup
symptoms.description: Monsoon damp breeds mould on the evaporator coil, and every restart blows that smell straight into the bedroom.

symptoms.title: Trips the MCB
symptoms.description: An ageing compressor or weak capacitor draws heavy current — made worse by voltage fluctuations — and keeps knocking the breaker out.

faqs.question: Is it worth repairing an old window AC or should I replace it?
faqs.answer: Usually worth repairing. Window ACs have simpler mechanicals than splits, parts are inexpensive, and a deep clean alone often restores most of the lost cooling. We will give you the repair quote alongside a realistic replacement cost and let you decide. If the compressor is gone on a very old unit, we will tell you that too.

faqs.question: How often should a window AC be serviced in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Twice a year. The dust load here is heavier than the once-a-year schedule most manuals assume, and coastal humidity accelerates coil corrosion. A service before summer and another after the monsoon keeps the unit efficient and the power bill in check.

faqs.question: What does a deep clean involve for a window unit?
faqs.answer: We pull the entire chassis out of its wall frame, sheet the room, and jet-wash both coils along with the blower and drain tray. The unit is then remounted with the correct outward tilt and sealed. It is the single most effective service for a dust-heavy Chennai home.

faqs.question: My window AC keeps tripping the breaker. Is that dangerous?
faqs.answer: Treat it as a warning, not a nuisance. Repeated tripping usually means a failing capacitor or a stressed compressor drawing excess current, often aggravated by voltage fluctuations. Resetting the MCB repeatedly risks damaging the compressor or the wiring, so stop using the unit and book a diagnosis.

faqs.question: Which window AC brands do you service?
faqs.answer: All major brands — Voltas, Blue Star, LG, Hitachi, Carrier, O General, Samsung and more. We also work on older and discontinued models, which are common in window units, sourcing compatible parts where originals are no longer made.
